title: Sample-and-Hold with Droop
constraints: Updated on each rising edge of `clk`: if `track = 1`, `vout = vin`; otherwise `vout = vout * DROOP`.
`DROOP` is a `real` parameter / generic (default 0.999). The judge uses `DROOP = 0.98`.
`vout` starts at 0.0. Compared with a 1e-9 V tolerance.
hints: It's one clocked process with an if/else on `track`.
The droop is multiplicative: after N hold cycles `vout = v_held · DROOPᴺ`, which models the hold capacitor leaking.
SystemVerilog: declare the output as `output real vout = 0.0` and assign it with a nonblocking assignment in `always @(posedge clk)`.
